# Distribution and downloads

## Install the proof of concept from source

1. Copy the entire [`METRIC8_RangeCheck`](../src/METRIC8_RangeCheck/) folder to `World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/`. The TOC should be directly inside `AddOns/METRIC8_RangeCheck/`.
2. Start WoW: Forever, enable **METRIC8: RangeCheck** in the AddOns list, and log in. Enter `/rangecheck` for controls.

This is development source (0.1.7-dev) targeting Forever 1.60.1 build 71037, interface 16001. See the [validation record](../docs/COMPATIBILITY.md). There is no published package or release.
